rules: Don't trade the accounts by hand
The bot sizes every trade to the room left. A hand trade can break the max loss or the best-day rule and end the account. To stop, use STOP BOT.

No trade for 7 calendar days and MFFU can close the account; on a funded account all its profit is lost. The bot pushes "no trade for 5 days". Then (and only then) place 1 MNQ in and out by hand. Watch holiday weeks.
30% of every payout to the tax pot
The day a payout lands, move 30% to a separate savings account. Next federal estimated tax payment: Jan 15, 2027.
